nodes.description_en:
Obtain free Zulip Cloud Standard sponsorship for marinaMoji, enabling web-public channels and long-term message retention without maintaining our own messaging server.

- [x] Submit the sponsorship application, presenting marinaMoji as an open-source academic project.
- [x] Receive confirmation of sponsorship and activation of the Standard plan.
- [x] Verify that web-public channels and full message history are available.

nodes.title_ja: Zulipチャットと公開フォーラム
nodes.description_en:
Establish Zulip as marinaMoji's public communication platform, combining internal development discussions with an open space for user questions, support, and feedback. Private and confidential exchanges remain separate.

- [x] Give Marina equal administrative control of the organization.
- [x] Create web-public channels: development, planning, design, outreach, feedback, and support.
- [x] Configure posting, invitation, and moderation permissions.
- [x] Publish a short welcome message and guidelines explaining public visibility and privacy.
- [x] Invite Matthias and any initial collaborators.
- [x] Test anonymous reading, account registration, posting, and mobile access.

nodes.title_ja: ウェブサイト連携（リンク＋アーカイブ）
nodes.description_en:
Make marinaMoji's public conversations accessible from the project website, providing clear entry points for community participation and a durable, independently hosted record of development.

- [x] Create a Community / Communauté page consistent with the existing website design.
- [x] Add direct links to the relevant Zulip channels for feedback, support, and development.
- [x] Add a clear notice that public discussions are archived.
- [x] Set up static HTML export of web-public Zulip conversations.
- [x] Publish the archive under marinamoji.crcao.fr.
- [x] Automate archive updates and verify links, readability, and mobile display.

nodes.description_en: After Milestone 2, run a lab beta with a small group for roughly six months. Collect and triage feedback from real use, then summarize unresolved issues and recommendations before Milestone 3. Completing this period is a prerequisite for Milestone 3.
nodes.description_fr: Après le jalon 2, organiser une bêta de laboratoire avec un petit groupe pendant environ six mois. Recueillir et trier les retours issus d’usages réels, puis résumer les problèmes non résolus et les recommandations avant le jalon 3. Cette période est un prérequis au jalon 3.
nodes.description_ja: マイルストーン2の後、小グループで約6か月間ラボベータを実施します。実際の利用からフィードバックを収集・整理し、マイルストーン3の前に未解決の問題と提案をまとめます。この期間の完了はマイルストーン3の前提条件です。
